name: io.github.tonyyang0504/paddle-mcp
description: Paddle (marketplaces): me, list_products, get_product, create_product, update_price, list_sales, lis

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_PADDLE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Paddle API key (Paddle > Developer tools > Authentication; live keys look like pdl_live_apikey_...) sent as Authorization: Bearer. Give it product.read, product.write, price.write, transaction.read, adjustment.read and adjustment.write permissions for the full tool set. Sandbox keys (pdl_sdbx_apikey_...) need base https://sandbox-api.paddle.com, which this server does not switch to.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_PADDLE_TAX_CATEGORY
environmentVariables.description: Tax category for create_product (POST /products requires it): standard, digital-goods, ebooks, implementation-services, professional-services, saas, software-programming-services, training-services or website-hosting. Only create_product needs it.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_PADDLE_ENV
environmentVariables.description: Vendor environment (default production): sandbox = https://sandbox-api.paddle.com. Credentials are the environment's own; see adapter.environments in the catalog entry.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_PADDLE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional https base URL override (a mock or a private gateway); replaces the selected environment's base_url. Never echoed in errors.
